summary: Campus turning circle with No Stopping signs; steep and busy with buildings close.
reasons: Four No Stopping Any Time signs

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by university buildings, footpaths and a pedestrian plaza; no homes but constant foot traffic.
drivers.access_and_room: Small paved turning circle at the road end; no clear space to stop out of the way.
drivers.traffic: Campus road with pedestrians and service vehicles.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time signs along the kerb; no overnight convention.

flags: Signs say no stopping; imagery shows no parked cars on the circle
sun_shade: Open paving with trees to the south-east; building shade from the west.
